summary: Parse and validate declared admission metadata in agent and mission KDL

replay.detail: No replay or backfill changes; this change validates new declaration authoring.

schema.detail: Uses the existing optional declared admission model fields; no storage schema, claim kind, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: KDL accepts declared-priority background or normal, declared-lane check or build, and declared-budgets with positive safe-integer CPU/token limits. Memory and disk sizes reuse the capacity memory grammar: plain byte counts or case-insensitive K/M/G/T binary suffixes, checked for overflow and required to be greater than zero. Invalid semantic values refuse authoring with invalid-declared-admission and the existing field-specific size message; strict KDL shape errors retain their syntax refusal codes.

compatibility.detail: Authoring is parsed and validated, but any declared-admission child, including an empty declared-budgets block, refuses the entire publication or direct declaration claim with declared-admission-feature-barrier until the publication gate lands. Direct claims are checked in both the persisted declaration body and schema-field envelopes, including explicit declared metadata fields; empty body or fields decoys cannot hide declarations. Child-name checks on intent.desired remain scoped to agent declarations; non-agent desired subjects may use those child names without triggering this barrier. This slice cannot write populated declared metadata; declarations without these children are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no data migration or backfill.

manual.detail: Authors may parse declared-priority, declared-lane and declared-budgets children, but cannot publish them until the companion fleet feature gate lands. These declarations are data only, not enforced; ST_SEAT_PRIORITY behavior is unchanged.

recovery.detail: This slice refuses all new declared-admission publication before writes, so reverting it introduces no populated declaration metadata to recover. Historical reads and replay remain unchanged.
